params.name: start_date
params.description: The start date in UTC (in the format YYYY-MM-DD) of the analysis window. When omitted, defaults to the earliest debit transaction available for the entity.

params.name: end_date
params.description: The end date in UTC (in the format YYYY-MM-DD) of the analysis window (inclusive — transactions on this date are included). When omitted, defaults to the current time.

items.docs: Enriches debit transactions with category, merchant, and location data, returning aggregated spend analytics  by category, merchant, and geography.
